invariants.text: 租户边界覆盖数据库 RLS、运行时上下文、事件、缓存和外部连接器。
经营事件、审批和关键回执只增不改；纠正通过新事件表达，不静默覆盖证据。
所有外部或变更性动作及其子调用，统一经过权限、PII、围栏和审批链路。
涉钱、敏感数据、群发、公开发布、交易和破坏性变更必须按高风险处理并由人审批。
没有真实回执就不能标记完成；mock、模拟和体验模式在数据结构与界面上都要明确区分。
客户原始经营数据不得上行；蜂群只接受白名单化、最小化、匿名化且可审计的元数据或派生经验。
租户覆盖层只能收紧围栏，不能放宽平台不可变红线。
模型、提示词、技能、bundle、策略和热更新必须先评测再灰度，且始终可回滚。
platform-ops、平台账户运营和平台秘密只属于 Andromeda。
Tiger 在获得单独的合规审查和用户明确授权前，只能模拟或纸面交易。
令牌、密码、API key、私钥、客户凭证和私密客户数据不得进入源码、文档、上下文、提示词、日志或提交。
个性化与行业扩展不得形成公共机制的第二事实源。

cards.title: Release QUEST gate accepts failed tasks and unrelated historical events

evidence.note: Actual original Q01 and Q02 callbacks both fail contract counterexamples: 0/2, exit1. Live T107 failed after original60s request abort.

cards.trigger_path: Dispatch returns failed with persisted multistep plan; Q01 checks only plan size/id. Q02 counts any recent workspace session instead of the new thread. Forced alphabetic preset is unrelated to the normal goal route.

assertions.given: One normal QUEST dispatch and exact thread plus failed/paused/queued/errored/unverified/malformed responses, current receipts and matching approval join
assertions.expect: Reject false completion and unrelated events; retain normal semantic route and finite single request; read current progress, exact session and verified distinct steps; guarded review remains pending and requires usable matching approval snapshot.

cards.fix_plan: Extract strict release QUEST proof helper, use normal dispatch route once within measured planner budget, and bind event/approval query to the exact new thread. Never retry dispatch or disable execution bridges/fences.
cards.blast_radius: Local experiment release tooling only; no base planner, task execution, approval, customer data or provider behavior change.
cards.rollback: Revert gate helper and wiring; preserve all failed thread/event/approval archives and keep release blocked until valid current receipts exist.
cards.notes: Source-only red/green tests do not prove live release chains. Full live gate requires official final-source payload and original native authentication.
